newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean values lower, corn steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean values lower, corn steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean basis values moved lower in deferred positions amid light dealings and possibly in reaction to higher CBOT soybean futures, grain dealers said.
Corn values were mostly unchanged in a quiet market.
Hard red winter wheat values were mostly unchanged and soft red winter wheat values were unavailable as some dealers remained on holiday.
In export news, Sri Lanka should tender early Friday for 50,000 tonnes each of optional origin soft and hard wheat, with the soft wheat for January shipment and hard for February.
